Delhi High Court Recalls Order Against 'The Wire' in Land Case

The Delhi High Court has recalled a previous order that had restrained news portal 'The Wire' from publishing future content related to the Bamnoli land acquisition case. The court stated that prior restraint on future publications was not appropriate. This decision comes after the court had initially issued the order against 'The Wire'.
